a division request completes within the long divider's latency

with neither enable asserted the unit does not signal a result

out_of_grammar.why_not_minable: the exact latency (MULL 2, MULH 3, DIV 36, divide-by-zero 1) is not a template shape: every template with a delay uses a window. The windows in MD2-MD5 are the minable approximation

assumptions.why: the environment supplies a non-zero divisor; the divide-by-zero guarantees are claimed under A3 instead
the environment supplies operands whose product fits in 32 bits
